title: Acsl1-Mediated Fatty Acid Synthesis Impairs Osseointegration in Type 1 Diabetes
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Diabetes mellitus is considered a relative contraindication to oral implant therapy, as hyperglycemia frequently precipitates vascular and osseous pathologies. Although clinicians routinely prioritize glycemic control before initiating implant-related ...
